name: SessionInfoButton

component.name: SessionInfoButton
component.description: Opens a panel with the session topic, session ID, your display name and user ID, and an optional invite link. The desktop panel can be dragged; mobile uses a bottom sheet.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS class for the button.

props.name: renderContent
props.description: Render custom leading content in place of the default Info icon.

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: Accessible label for the button and panel. Defaults to "Session Info".

props.name: isMobile
props.description: Shows the panel in a mobile bottom sheet instead of the desktop panel. Not detected automatically. The sheet closes when you swipe it down, tap outside it, or use its close button.

props.name: panelClassName
props.description: Additional CSS class for the desktop session info panel.

props.name: panelStyle
props.description: Inline styles for the desktop session info panel.

props.name: anchor
props.description: Anchors the desktop panel to this element instead of the button. Pass an HTML element or any object with getBoundingClientRect(). Ignored on mobile.

props.name: popoverProps
props.description: Initial position of the desktop panel: side, align, sideOffset, alignOffset, and collisionPadding. By default the panel opens below the button, aligned to its start edge, and moves to the opposite side when there isn't enough room. Ignored on mobile.

props.name: onClose
props.description: Called when the panel closes, including when the mobile sheet is dismissed. On desktop, the panel closes only when you click the button again or use the panel's close button.

props.name: inviteLink
props.description: Invite URL supplied by your application. Shows a copyable link in the panel; omit or leave empty to hide it.

props.name: showSessionName
props.description: Shows the session topic next to the info icon.

displayedFields.description: Session metadata is read automatically. Rows appear in this order. The invite link comes from the inviteLink prop and is hidden when empty.

fields.inviteLink: string (from the inviteLink prop; row hidden when empty)

notes: Displays the session topic, session ID, and your display name and user ID. The session password is not shown.
Supply inviteLink to show an invite link and its copy action. Session ID also supports copying.
Use SessionInfoButton for a managed trigger and popup, or SessionInfoPanel inside a custom surface.
On desktop, the panel closes only when you click the button again or use the panel's close button.
The button is disabled until the session is connected.

types.name: SessionInfoButtonPopoverProps
types.description: Initial placement of the desktop session info panel.

fields.name: side
fields.description: Preferred side of the button or anchor. Moves to the opposite side when there isn't enough room.

fields.name: sideOffset
fields.description: Distance from the button or anchor, in pixels.

fields.name: alignOffset
fields.description: Offset from the chosen alignment, in pixels.

fields.name: collisionPadding
fields.description: Minimum gap kept from the viewport edges, in pixels.

types.name: VirtualElement
types.description: Not exported by name. Pass an HTML element, or any object with a getBoundingClientRect() method that returns a DOMRect.

fields.name: getBoundingClientRect
fields.description: Returns the position and size to anchor to.
